overview_description.description: Floward is an online flowers and gifts eCommerce solution sourced from local and international brands with same-day delivery schedules. It has been expanding aggressively and currently operates in 36 cities across nine countries in the MENA region and United Kingdom, offering same-day delivery for all orders. It expanded to its first market outside the Middle East in December 2020 with the launch of its platform in London.
